remarks: Welcome to this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath condo in the Windsong Community, offering stylish, modern finishes and easy living! The covered front porch leads to the beautiful second-floor entryway. The thoughtfully designed interior features a contemporary and inviting aesthetic with current finishes throughout, including neutral paint colors and hardwood flooring. The open and spacious layout creates a seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining! The beautifully appointed kitchen features timeless white cabinets, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a pantry, an eating area with plantation shutters, and a breakfast bar that combine style and functionality. The kitchen adjoins the great room, which features soaring ceilings, an electric fireplace, and a sliding door to the comfortable balcony that overlooks greenspace! Both spacious bedrooms are well-designed; one offers an ensuite full bath, plantation shutters, and a generous walk-in closet. The second bedroom also features plantation shutters and is sizable enough to serve as an office or den if needed. A second full bathroom and a convenient laundry room add comfort and convenience, along with plenty of storage. Enjoy the ease of low-maintenance condo living, with lawn and snow removal, just to name a few conveniences included. A bonus is a garage for parking and storage, plus ample open parking for guests. This move-in-ready condo blends modern style, comfort, and convenience, and is just minutes from expressways, downtown Buffalo, all suburbs, and everyday necessities. This pristine condo is a must-see!
